title: A Message to Grandma
description: Practise past simple and present simple, and write a short message to your grandma.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.text: Dear Grandma, I ___ you very much.
exercises.explanation: Use "miss" with I: I miss you.

exercises.text: 🦁 Last week I ___ to the zoo with Dad. (go)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Thank you for + thing: Thank you for my present.

exercises.text: I ___ your cake yesterday. It was lovely.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I are happy because it is your birthday.
answers: I am happy because it is your birthday.

exercises.text: Please come ___ see us on Sunday.
exercises.explanation: Use "come to see" or "come and see".

exercises.text: 🎨 My sister ___ a picture for you.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + want to + verb: I want to visit you.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My brother have a new bike.
answers: My brother has a new bike.
exercises.explanation: Use "has" with he, she and it.

exercises.text: I want to ___ you a long letter.
exercises.explanation: After "want to" use the base verb: send.

exercises.text: I am your grandson. ___ name is Nam.
exercises.explanation: Use "my" for something that belongs to me.

exercises.text: How ___ you? I hope you are well.
exercises.explanation: Use "are" with you: How are you?

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Put the time word first or last: Yesterday we saw a film.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Grandma, you are the good cook in the world.
answers: Grandma, you are the best cook in the world.

exercises.text: ❤️ We ___ happy to see you last week. (be)
exercises.explanation: Use "were" with we in the past.

task.prompt: Write a short message to your grandma. Tell her about your week.
contentPoints: Say hello and ask how she is.
Say what you did last weekend.
Say what you want to do with her.
task.modelAnswer:
Dear Grandma,

How are you? I miss you very much. Last weekend I went to the park with my dad and we played football. I want to visit you soon. Can we make a cake together?

Love from,
Mai
